answer: A mesa of bonded identities is sustained when each agent stakes a costly deposit that is slashed upon proven misbehavior, so honest participation dominates. Each nebula of pseudonyms must post the same deposit, making k fake identities cost k times the stake and eliminating the cheap-sybil advantage. The nadir is that colluding whales can still fund many deposits, so weighting influence by stake duration and capping per-entity weight limits capture.
